description:
House of DaVoice is an independent fragrance brand offering elevated Eau de Parfum inspired by beloved fragrance profiles and reimagined with our own identity. 

Affiliates earn 10% commission on qualifying referral sales using their unique affiliate link or coupon code, with a 30-day tracking cookie.

Please note: The average order value currently displayed by UpPromote reflects historical store sales and is expected to increase as House of DaVoice fragrance sales become a larger share of store orders. Currently, our fragrances vary in price from $39 to $69 per bottle.

Our growing collection includes feminine, masculine, and unisex fragrances across gourmand, floral, woody, fresh, and amber fragrance families.

We welcome fragrance reviewers, beauty creators, lifestyle creators, bloggers, social media creators, and other authentic content publishers who enjoy introducing their audiences to fragrance. Affiliates may promote House of DaVoice through original reviews, fragrance recommendations, styling and lifestyle content, social media posts, videos, blogs, and other approved content.

We're especially interested in creators who genuinely enjoy fragrance and can introduce House of DaVoice to their audience in an authentic, engaging way.
payout_period: Commissions are reviewed after the order is fulfilled and the return period has passed. Approved commissions are paid monthly via PayPal.
term_and_condition:
House of DaVoice Affiliate Program Terms & Conditions

Welcome to the House of DaVoice Affiliate Program. We are excited to work with creators, fragrance enthusiasts, reviewers, and other partners who want to share House of DaVoice with their audiences.

By applying to or participating in the House of DaVoice Affiliate Program (“Program”), you (“Affiliate”) agree to these Terms & Conditions.

1. Affiliate Approval

All applications are subject to review and approval by House of DaVoice. We reserve the right to approve or reject an application at our discretion.

Participation in the Program is currently intended for affiliates promoting to customers within the United States, as House of DaVoice currently ships within the United States.

2. Affiliate Commission

Approved affiliates earn a 10% commission on qualifying referral sales attributed to their affiliate link or assigned coupon code.

Commission is calculated on the eligible product value of the order and excludes shipping charges, taxes, discounts, refunds, returns, cancellations, chargebacks, and other non-product charges.

Commissions are not earned on an Affiliate's own purchases, fraudulent transactions, or transactions otherwise determined to be ineligible.

House of DaVoice may review referral transactions before approving commissions.

3. Referral Tracking

Approved Affiliates receive a unique referral link and may also receive a personal coupon code.

The Program currently uses a 30-day referral window. When a potential customer follows an Affiliate's referral link, eligible purchases made within the applicable tracking period may be attributed to that Affiliate according to the Program's tracking rules.

Tracking depends on available browser and platform technologies. House of DaVoice cannot guarantee attribution when cookies or other tracking technologies are blocked, deleted, unavailable, or otherwise prevented from functioning.

If both an Affiliate link and Affiliate coupon are associated with the same purchase, only one commission will be earned on that transaction.

4. Affiliate Promotion

Affiliates may promote House of DaVoice through approved channels including social media, websites, blogs, video content, email audiences, and other legitimate promotional channels.

Affiliates must represent House of DaVoice and its products accurately and must not make false, misleading, deceptive, or unsubstantiated claims about our products.

Affiliates may use marketing materials provided by House of DaVoice. House of DaVoice trademarks, logos, product photography, and other brand assets may be used only for legitimate promotion of the Affiliate's participation in the Program and may not be altered or used in a manner that misrepresents the brand.

5. Inspired-By Fragrance Marketing

Certain House of DaVoice fragrances may be described as inspired by well-known fragrance profiles for comparison and identification purposes.

Affiliates must not state or imply that House of DaVoice is manufactured by, affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, or officially connected with any designer fragrance house or trademark owner unless House of DaVoice expressly provides such authorization.

Affiliates should use the official product names and product descriptions provided by House of DaVoice when promoting our fragrances.

6. Affiliate Disclosures

Affiliates are responsible for clearly and conspicuously disclosing their relationship with House of DaVoice whenever required by applicable advertising and endorsement laws or regulations.

Affiliate content should clearly communicate that the Affiliate may earn a commission from purchases made through their referral link or coupon code. Appropriate disclosures may include terms such as “Ad,” “Sponsored,” or “Affiliate,” when appropriate.

Disclosures should be placed where consumers can easily see and understand them rather than being hidden within hashtags, links, or other content.

7. Prohibited Promotional Practices

Affiliates may not engage in spam, deceptive advertising, false claims, trademark impersonation, fraudulent transactions, cookie stuffing, forced clicks, unauthorized coupon distribution, or any practice intended to improperly obtain referral credit.

Affiliates may not create websites, domains, social-media accounts, advertisements, or other properties that falsely appear to be operated by or officially represent House of DaVoice.

Unless specifically authorized in writing, Affiliates may not bid on House of DaVoice trademarks, brand names, product names, or confusingly similar terms through paid search advertising.

Affiliate links and coupon codes may not be distributed through unauthorized coupon, deal, cashback, or similar websites without prior approval.

8. Product Samples, Gifts & Promotional Opportunities

House of DaVoice may occasionally offer product samples, gifts, bonuses, increased commissions, or other promotional opportunities to selected Affiliates.

Participation in the Affiliate Program does not guarantee free products, samples, paid sponsorships, or other compensation beyond commissions earned on qualifying sales unless separately agreed upon.

9. Returns, Refunds & Chargebacks

Commissions are payable only on qualifying completed transactions. Commissions associated with returned, refunded, cancelled, fraudulent, or charged-back transactions may be declined, reversed, or deducted from future Affiliate earnings where appropriate.

10. Payment

Affiliates are responsible for providing accurate payment information through their Affiliate Dashboard.

Approved commissions will be paid according to the payment schedule and payment methods established by House of DaVoice and displayed within the Affiliate Program.

Affiliates are responsible for any taxes or reporting obligations associated with payments they receive through the Program.

11. Independent Affiliate Relationship

Participation in the Program does not create an employment, partnership, franchise, agency, or joint-venture relationship between an Affiliate and House of DaVoice.

Affiliates are independent participants and are responsible for their own content, business activities, expenses, taxes, and compliance with applicable laws and platform policies.

12. Program Suspension or Termination

House of DaVoice reserves the right to suspend or terminate an Affiliate account for violation of these Terms, suspected fraud, misuse of the Program, misleading promotion, conduct harmful to the House of DaVoice brand, or other reasonable Program-related concerns.

Affiliates may leave the Program at any time by contacting support@houseofdavoice.com.

13. Changes to the Program

House of DaVoice may modify these Terms, commission rates, referral periods, promotional rules, or other Program features from time to time. Material Program changes will be communicated through the Affiliate Dashboard, email, or other reasonable means when appropriate.

Continued participation after updated Terms become effective constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

14. Questions

Questions regarding the House of DaVoice Affiliate Program may be sent to:

support@houseofdavoice.com

Thank you for being part of the House of DaVoice Affiliate Program.

Share the Scent. Earn Rewards.
